audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 fits 48.64% over 1548 games — Irelia holds the pre-6 levels, Lissandra's chain owns the level 6 window.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldowns anywhere. Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1 falling to 12s at rank 5 — the single number that decides whether she can leave — and Frozen Tomb is 120s at rank 1.
audit.why: Her immobility while the claw is down is the whole reason Irelia wins levels 3-5.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, ahead, early, spikes[0].text and wants.you[0] now carry the numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frozen Tomb self-cast makes Lissandra untargetable and invulnerable while healing her — dumping your combo into it wastes everything. Also unstated: Ring of Frost is only 450 range, so your 850-range stun beats it outright, and Iceborn Subjugation leaves slowing thralls on corpses.
audit.why: The untargetable window is the most common way an Irelia loses this fight, and it also sets the Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.corrected: Added to dosFull[1].d, phases[4].why, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly calls Glacial Path a root and claims it self-roots Lissandra on cast (whys[0], early, wants.you[0], spikes[0].text). Riot's text gives Glacial Path damage and a recast teleport — no root, on her or on you. Her root is Ring of Frost (W).
audit.why: Advising the reader to wait for a self-root that the ability does not have would have them commit into a mobile Lissandra.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten around the real 24s claw cooldown and Ring of Frost as the root.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read 'Skill' while content win[] reads Irelia ×4, Lissandra at level 6, then Irelia ×2.
audit.why: Packet levelChart matches the content layer exactly; the full-layer side tokens were stale.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned with ratings and whys rewritten in the same proposal; win[N] already matches so no content chart edit is needed.

edits.before: - Lissandra Glacial Path (Claw): matchup-defining — Her engage and escape in one button — she is immobile while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Defiant Dance has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Glacial Path is 24s at rank 1 and still 12s at rank 5 — with the claw spent she has no exit at all. - Ring of Frost is 10s but only reaches 450, so land your 850 stun first. - Ice Shard is 7s at rank 1. - Frozen Tomb is 120s at rank 1 and her whole all-in waits on it.

notes: Corrected a repeated kit error: the content layer treated Glacial Path as a root and as self-rooting Lissandra on cast. Riot's text gives it damage plus a recast teleport only; her root is Ring of Frost (450 range). Also added the Frozen Tomb self-cast interaction (untargetable, invulnerable, heals) which was flagged in _missing and appeared nowhere on the page — it is the main way an Irelia wastes a full combo here. breakdown.wave and breakdown.early left templated; the kit gives no Lissandra-specific wave hook.
